title: Watch the teaser trailer for 'Invincible' Season 5, coming to Prime Video February 17
summary: 'The Boys' star Jack Quaid will join the fifth season of the critically acclaimed animated superhero series.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Invincible


Season 5 premieres February 17, 2027, on Prime Video worldwide.


- The Boys


star Jack Quaid joins the cast this season as Gravitator/Chris.


- Prime Video has already announced a sixth season.


---


Invincible


is returning for a thrilling new season.


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) has announced the release date for


Invincible


Season 5 with a fun teaser trailer, which takes place at the fan-favorite fast-food restaurant Burger Mart.


The critically acclaimed adult animated superhero series will debut February 17, 2027, on Prime Video.


['Fallout' Season 3 is coming to Prime Video: Everything you need to know](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fallout-season-2-season-3-prime-video)


The hit series based on the popular video game franchise will return for a third season.


Here's everything you need to know about


Invincible


Season 5, from cast details to how to watch.


## What is 'Invincible' Season 5 about?


In Season 5, Mark Grayson is still reeling from his role in the earth-shattering events of last season, searching for a way to make the world better. That may mean risking everything, including the relationships, friends, and allies he holds dear.


Mark is forced to decide what kind of hero he is and what he’s willing to do to save his planet’s future. Do the ends always justify the means when millions of lives hang in the balance?


## When is the 'Invincible' Season 5 release date?


Invincible


Season 5 will debut on February 17, 2027, in more than 240 countries and territories.


Ahead of the Season 5 debut, you can watch the previous four seasons of


[Invincible](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/invincible-season-3-prime-video) on Prime Video now worldwide.


[Season 4](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/invincible-season-4-prime-video)


is the most-watched installment in the series’ history, growing the show's audience from prior seasons and continuing its critically acclaimed streak with a third straight 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes.


Prime Video is included in your


[Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) , which costs $14.99 a month or $139 a year in the United States. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and qualifying


[government assistance](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) recipients at 50% off. Please check your local Amazon website for Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a 30-day


[free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


## Who is in the 'Invincible' Season 5 cast?


Invincible


stars Steven Yeun as Mark Grayson/Invincible, Sandra Oh as Debbie Grayson, and J.K. Simmons as Nolan Grayson/Omni-Man.


[How to watch ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ Season 3, streaming now on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/lord-of-the-rings-rings-of-power-season-3-prime-video)


The latest season of Prime Video’s epic saga features new characters including Jamie Campbell Bower as Celeborn.


The ensemble cast also includes Jonathan Banks, Eric Bauza, Clancy Brown, Christian Convery, Grey DeLisle, Zoey Deutch, Chris Diamantopoulos, Walton Goggins, Danai Gurira, Mark Hamill, Gillian Jacobs, Jason Mantzoukas, Ross Marquand, Tatiana Maslany, Lee Pace, Aaron Paul, Khary Payton, Jay Pharoah, Kevin Michael Richardson, Seth Rogen, Matthew Rhys, and Ben Schwartz.


Season 5 will see


[The Boys](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/the-boys-eric-kripke-season-5-prime-video) star Jack Quaid make his


Invincible


debut, joining the cast as Gravitator/Chris.


Invincible


secured consecutive


[Primetime Emmy Award nominations](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/emmys-amazon-mgm-studios-prime-video) in voice acting for 2024, 2025, and 2026.


## Will there be an 'Invincible' Season 6?


Yes. Prime Video has already announced a sixth season, making it the streaming service's longest-running animated series to date.


## Who is the team behind 'Invincible'?


Invincible


is based on the award-winning comic book series by co-creators Robert Kirkman and Cory Walker, and contributing creator Ryan Ottley.


The series is produced by Skybound Entertainment’s in-house animation studio, Skybound Animation.


The executive producers are Kirkman, David Alpert, Simon Racioppa, Margaret M. Dean, Catherine Winder, Seth Rogen, and Evan Goldberg. The co-executive producers are Helen Leigh and Walker.
